item.title: Word of the Day: Preeminent
item.description: Phonetic: /pree-EM-uh-nunt/ Part of Speech: Adjective Definition Preeminent is a formal word used to describe someone or something more important, skillful, or successful than their counterparts or peers. It is used synonymously with outstanding and supreme. She’s the preeminent chef in a city renowned for its cuisine.

item.title: Alexandria Police assist Louisiana State Police in joint operation
item.description: The Alexandria Police Department recently assisted the Louisiana State Police during a joint operation involving an active case.
